title: Covariance and nonconstant Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $f,g$ be real-valued functions on the sign cube of dimension $n$. Their covariance equals $\mathbb E[fg]-\mathbb E[f]\mathbb E[g]$, and it also equals $\sum_{\varnothing\ne S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}\widehat f(S)\widehat g(S)$, where $\widehat f(S)$ and $\widehat g(S)$ are their Fourier coefficients.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued functions $f,g$ on the sign cube of dimension $n$
